disclosure_model.principle: current situation -> meaningful target -> contextual reveal -> deep task surface when needed -> exact semantic return

depths.D0: Re-entry/orientation: current Production, current situation, resume point, concise current meaning, subordinate routes.
depths.D1: Current task/Stage: current Scene/live Stage or other current Production task is primary.
depths.D2: Contextual reveal: nearby information about selected meaningful element or directly relevant cause.
depths.D3: Deep task surface: deeper Character inspection, expanded causal history, Production-level Character access, bounded perspective, technical detail, or another separately authorized focused task.
depths.R: Return: restore originating semantic target and keyboard focus when still valid.

disclosure_model.note: D0/D1/D2/D3/R are Design presentation-depth shorthand only; they are not Product modes, runtime states, or visible labels.

frozen_static_rules: Home is resume-first/current-situation-first, not a Production-library dashboard.
Stage/current task dominates when live work is active.
Focus precedes and remains independent from creator selection.
Creator selection establishes contextual origin without changing fiction.
Contextual reveal is invoked, nearby, and subordinate to the primary task.
Deep Character inspection preserves persistent identity and current Scene origin.
Whole-Production Character access preserves current Scene selection and does not add off-Scene Characters to the Scene.
Current performance may expose directly relevant causal context while current/historical status stays explicit.
Expanded history is a transient/deep route, not a permanent Archive rail.
Character-bounded perspective is a disclosure transformation inside the same Production.
No active Scene is a valid state and must not cause invented Stage/Scene lifecycle UI.
Loading/unavailable/recovery/provisional states remain application truth outside fiction.
Return restores semantic origin, creator selection and focus when valid; Back/Close is not Undo.
Wide/medium/narrow change presentation density, not semantic meaning.
White and Black preserve identical disclosure order and behavior.
open_variables: native WinUI surface classes and runtime accessibility behavior

contradictions_found_and_resolved: Historical fixed inspector/right-rail treatments are reduced to contextual/transient capacities.
Historical People/World/Scenes category pressure is not carried forward as default navigation; situation-first disclosure governs.
History remains causal/deep rather than a permanent Archive rail.
Whole-Production Character management is retained as a task route without changing current Scene selection or creating a Character top-level silo.
Technical/loading/recovery states retain application truth and cannot enter fictional Stage semantics.
